notes.title: Version 1.3.7
notes.content:
This update adds some quality of life changes and some performance updates

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Configuration Profiles
[*] Tracker Profiles
[*]  Video Quality selector
[*] Improved tracking accuracy
[*] Lip Syncing
[*] Spout 2 Support
[*] New "Glass" grounds for enviroment
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] VMC Sending now sends the correct scale
[*] Various tracking fixes
[/list]

[h2]Spout2[/h2]
With Spout2 support, you can now record VrmFrontView with better performance.
To start using with obs you will need to download [url=https://github.com/Off-World-Live/obs-spout2-plugin]obs-spout 2 plugin [/url]

notes.title: Patch 12/6/2025
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where some ui buttons are not clickable
- Support for different file to transmit in VMC. this will allow different vrm to be loaded in VrmFrontView and the VMC receiving application, this will allow you to send NVRM file to Beatsaber using Naluluna Avatar mod
